user.title: Light Timer
user.description: Create the Light Timer integration. Manage lights from the integration's Configure options once setup completes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Light Timer is already configured. To add or manage lights, go to Settings → Devices & Services → Light Timer → Configure.

init.title: Light Timer
init.description: Add, edit, or remove a managed light.

add_light.title: Add a managed light
add_light.description: Choose a light and configure its timer.

edit_light.title: Edit a managed light
edit_light.description: Choose which managed light to edit.

edit_light_details.title: Edit {light_entity_id}
edit_light_details.description: Update the timer settings for {light_entity_id}. The light cannot be changed.

remove_light.title: Remove a managed light
remove_light.description: Choose which managed light to remove.

remove_light_confirm.title: Remove {light_entity_id}
remove_light_confirm.description: Remove {light_entity_id} from Light Timer? This stops its timer and removes its entities.

error.range: Value must be an integer between 1 and 86400 seconds.
error.integer: Value must be a whole number (integer).
error.already_managed: That light is already managed by Light Timer.
error.entity_not_found: That entity was not found in Home Assistant.
error.not_a_light: The selected entity is not a light.

abort.no_lights: There are no managed lights to act on.

cancel.name: Cancel timer
cancel.description: Cancel the running countdown for the targeted managed light(s), leaving the light on.

suspend.name: Suspend timer
suspend.description: Suspend timer automation for the targeted managed light(s).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Suspension period in seconds (integer in [1, 86400]). When omitted the light's configured default suspension is used.
